headline: MOGUL v11.4 — elections + scrutiny + alliances/rivals
summary: V11-9 steps 4+5+6 complete the power system. Player can now run for national office in any of 12 nations, with NPC opponents drawn from the leaderboard bot pool and ±10-15% randomness. Winning grants +50 influence but raises scrutiny by 15. Scrutiny rises yearly with power (industry mogul +2, influencer +4, national power +7, state leader +10), extra +3 if influence>500, falls by 0.5 per transparency point. At scrutiny≥80, election margin takes a hit; at ≥95 you cannot run. Scandals fire at 0-30%/year scaled by scrutiny (doubled if 'accept risk'). Player can form alliances with leaderboard bots (20 influence, +30 strength, decays -5/year) or break with them (turns hostile, +50 hostility). Alliances give +5% election margin per strength point (cap +25%); rivals apply -5% margin per hostility (cap -25%). Four endings at game over: sustainable (state_leader + won + scrutiny<50), respected (national_power+ + won + scrutiny<70), overthrown (scrutiny≥80 OR recalled), reclusive (never unlocked a power tier).
features: Elections: 12 nations with common framework (opponent strength + randomness + term length)
Election margin = base + influence bonus + alliance bonus − rival penalty − scrutiny penalty − opponent strength ± noise
Election cost: 80 influence per run; win grants +50 influence + +15 scrutiny, loss grants +5 scrutiny
Scrutiny meter (0-100): rises with power tier + high influence, falls with transparency
3 transparency actions: independent board (+20 transparency, 40 influence), disclosure reports (+15, 30 influence), accept risk (free, doubles scandal chance)
Alliances: form/refresh with leaderboard bots (20 influence, +30 strength, decays −5/year)
Rivals: break with a bot (hostility +50), bump hostility by +20 if already a rival
Alliance bonus = +0.5% margin per strength point (cap +25%); rival penalty = −0.5% per hostility (cap −25%)
Scandal events: 0-30%/year scaled by scrutiny (doubled if accept-risk); scandal → scrutiny +10, rivals +15, influence −5
Four game-over endings: sustainable, respected, overthrown, reclusive — written to Hall of Fame note
PowerTab expanded with scrutiny meter, transparency actions, election panel, alliance/rival list
Version bumped to v11.4 on homepage + version.json
